# sync_time

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

The time one object waited to synchronize with another object at a shared event.

| `seconds` | `float` | yes | Synchronization wait duration in seconds. |
